name: combo
when: Finishing a whole candy run (a group of candy collected in one go).

name: spill
when: Candy spilling out of the bucket when the kid gets hit.

name: bounce
when: Bouncing on a trampoline, bouncy pumpkin, shop awning or car hood.

name: treats
when: Treats handed out at the door (plays with the doorbell).

name: cleared
when: A house cleared: all of its candy collected (its porch lights up).

name: freed
when: An area freed: every nest and thorn nest destroyed (Save the Town).

name: fire
when: Casting a fireball from the wand.

name: hit
when: A fireball hitting a monster, nest or vine.

name: hit_kill
when: A fireball hit that destroys its target.

name: fizzle
when: A fireball hitting a wall or running out.

name: telegraph
when: A monster winding up an attack (warning).

name: nest_break
when: A monster nest or thorn nest destroyed.

name: throw
when: A monster throwing a bone or goo.

name: spawn
when: A monster emerging from its nest.

name: menu
when: Opening a menu (shop, travel gate, pause).

name: denied
when: Trying to buy something you can't afford or haven't unlocked.

name: purchase
when: Buying or equipping in the shop, and finding a costume.

name: car_summon
when: The Pumpkin Cruiser poofing in next to the kid.
